newsitem.title: USA: ComEd Dresden 3 nuclear unit in startup.
newsitem.headline: ComEd Dresden 3 nuclear unit in startup.

text.p: Commonwealth Edison Co's 794 megawatt (MW) Dresden 3 nuclear power unit, in Morris, Ill., is in startup Thursday, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said in its morning plant status report.
The unit, shut since October 26 for maintenance, was operating at two percent power as of early this morning, the NRC report stated.
The adjacent unit 2, with an identical generating capacity, is operating at full power.
ComEd is a subsidiary of Unicom Corp.
